source.text: Have histologically or cytologically confirmed, metastatic, or unresectable solid tumor
Have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 to 1 at screening
Active Central Nervous System (CNS) involvement with the exception of locally treated brain metastases that are clinically stable and asymptomatic for \> 2 weeks
History of solid organ or hematologic stem cell transplantation
